scenes.conflict: Dorian Pell, secretly spying on her for the Tithe Lamp, charms his way into her work and probes what she has found, while she guards her findings out of habit.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants to confirm that the Tithe Lamp's air accounts show the bell-tides weakening and that her father's debt was forged.
scenes.outcome: Iselda confirms the pattern using her Breath-Ledger Reckoning but conceals it from Dorian, who reports that she has found something. The Tithe Lamp starts to watch her.
scenes.summary: In the lamplit market of the Nave Concourse, Iselda finds telling discrepancies in the air accounts. Dorian befriends her while quietly gauging her discovery.
scenes.title: The Ledger That Does Not Balance

scenes.conflict: Corvin works through proxies because violence is forbidden in the nave, and Dorian's greed pulls him between two masters.
scenes.goal: Corvin wants leverage over the Tithe Lamp and the Ringers' secret, and Dorian wants payment for what he knows.
scenes.outcome: Dorian sells word of Iselda's discovery to Corvin, who resolves to coerce or discredit her and to press the Ringers.
scenes.summary: Beneath shifting stained-glass light, Corvin learns through the bribed Dorian that a clerk holds evidence about the bell. He begins to move against her.
scenes.title: An Audience in the Choir

scenes.conflict: The stored testimony is fragmentary and implicates her own House, forcing her to face the possibility that it ruined her family.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants glass testimony to prove the weakening tides and the hoarding of air.
scenes.outcome: She has partial proof that air is being hoarded and the tides are failing, but she needs the Ringers to confirm it. Her loyalty to the Tithe Lamp begins to break.
scenes.summary: Using Glass Reading, Iselda draws testimony from sealed vials and finds the Tithe Lamp's hand in her father's forged debt and the tide shortfall.
scenes.title: What the Windows Remember

scenes.conflict: Maera's habit of secrecy makes her deny and deflect, and she fears that sharing the truth will panic the city.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants Maera to confirm the bell-tides are weakening.
scenes.outcome: Maera neither confirms nor denies but lets Iselda stay, so a wary alliance begins. She warns that both powers are hunting the same truth.
scenes.summary: Iselda descends into the flooded undercroft and confronts the Keeper-Ringer beside the black water and the great bell.
scenes.title: Descent to the Bell

scenes.conflict: Sable distrusts anyone tied to a House and suspects Iselda will draw enforcers to the crypt, while Iselda withholds details about her evidence.
scenes.goal: Iselda needs a way to move her evidence out of the Tithe Lamp's reach, and Sable wants to protect the heretics hiding in the crypt.
scenes.outcome: Sable agrees to smuggle the evidence through the glass guilds if Iselda keeps the heretics' hiding place secret. Iselda's secrecy leaves the pact fragile.
scenes.summary: Sable's skiff offers the only route out for Iselda's proof, and the two bargain over trust and risk.
scenes.title: A Skiff Among the Tombs

scenes.conflict: Oath-binding bargains and hired proxies threaten her without breaking the ban on blood in the nave, and Dorian's divided loyalty pulls him between his guilt and his bribes.
scenes.goal: Corvin wants Iselda's ledgers or her discredit, and Iselda wants to keep them and stay safe.
scenes.outcome: Iselda escapes a binding obligation, but the ledgers are partly compromised. She realizes Dorian has been reporting on her.
scenes.summary: Corvin acts through proxies in the Concourse, using oaths and contracts to corner Iselda. Her escape exposes Dorian's betrayal.
scenes.title: Pressure Through Proxies

scenes.conflict: Corvin threatens the Ringers through oaths and proxies, while Maera stonewalls and sells only partial silence.
scenes.goal: Corvin wants Maera to reveal the bell's secret, and Maera wants to keep it hidden until the Ringers can restore the tides.
scenes.outcome: Maera holds her secret but is shaken, and she fears the bell may answer to something older than the Ringers. She decides she must trust Iselda.
scenes.summary: Corvin's pressure on the Ringers reaches the crypt, and Maera deflects him while her private doubts about the bell grow.
scenes.title: The Price of Silence

scenes.conflict: His flattery and divided loyalties collide with her distrust, and his confession could cost him his advancement.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants to know who Dorian has reported to, and Dorian wants to keep her trust and his place.
scenes.outcome: Dorian admits to spying for both the Tithe Lamp and the Pale Mitre. Iselda keeps him close for what he can reveal, and he is torn between his masters and her.
scenes.summary: Iselda confronts Dorian in the market, and he confesses to being bribed by Corvin's proxies while spying for the Tithe Lamp.
scenes.title: The Broker's Guilt

scenes.conflict: Maera's lifelong secrecy and her fear that the bell serves something older clash with the city's dwindling air, and Iselda's own habit of hoarding information strains the alliance.
scenes.goal: Iselda needs the Ringers' confirmation, and Maera must decide whether to share what she has held for decades.
scenes.outcome: Maera entrusts Iselda with the truth that the tides are weakening and records it in the glass. Iselda shares everything with Sable instead of keeping it back.
scenes.summary: Beside the great bell, Maera confirms the failing tides to Iselda and Sable, and the three plan to put the truth before the city.
scenes.title: What the Keeper Knew

scenes.conflict: Corvin invokes ritual precedent and oaths to silence her, while the windows record every word spoken. Dorian must choose between advancement and protecting Iselda, and Iselda stakes her own breath-standing on the truth.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants to expose the bell's failing tides and the air hoarding publicly, and Corvin wants to bind the Tithe Lamp in scandal and seize sovereign control of the air.
scenes.outcome: Iselda reveals the testimony publicly and stakes her breath-standing on it, and Dorian sacrifices his advancement to back her. Corvin refuses to admit error and his own recorded words undo him.
scenes.summary: At the noble court's own audience, Iselda presents the glass testimony and Maera's confirmation, and Corvin's words, captured by the windows, expose his bid for control.
scenes.title: Testimony in the Choir

scenes.conflict: The Tithe Lamp reacts to its exposure and the air accounts are in turmoil, while Dorian has lost his path to the directors' seats.
scenes.goal: Iselda wants her father's forged debt cleared, and Dorian wants to face the consequences of his choice.
scenes.outcome: The forged debt is struck from the record and the hoarded air is exposed. Dorian loses his advancement but gains Iselda's friendship, and her brother is freed from owing.
scenes.summary: The Concourse reels as the Tithe Lamp's hoarding is revealed and Iselda's family debt is cleared.
scenes.title: Debts Called

scenes.conflict: His own recorded words and his private doubts about the Pale Mitre's oaths confront his pride, and he cannot admit error.
scenes.goal: Corvin wants to preserve the illusion of his line's legitimacy.
scenes.outcome: Corvin clings to the illusion and his standing collapses, and the Pale Mitre loses its claim to sovereign control of the air.
scenes.summary: In the empty Choir, Corvin faces the testimony of his own words and the hollowness of his line's oaths.
scenes.title: The Hollow Oath

scenes.conflict: The bell's nature remains unknown, and the heretics and Ringers must step into the light and trust one another.
scenes.goal: The three want the city to face the failing tides together and find a way to restore them.
scenes.outcome: The Ringers confess openly and the crypt's heretics join the shared search for a way to restore the tides. The truth is now common, and the city faces the uncertain future together.
scenes.summary: In the crypt, Iselda, Maera and Sable commit to a shared effort as the bell tolls over the black water.
scenes.title: The Bell Tolls for All

logline: When clerk Iselda Vane discovers that the bell-tides sustaining a drowned cathedral city are failing, she must expose the truth before Lord Corvin Halewick and the Tithe Lamp seize the dwindling air for themselves and the city suffocates.
theme: Shared truth is the only breath that sustains a drowning people.
title: Abyssal Courts
